name: @misabegovic/pi-brain
description: A cozy knowledge home for pi. Distributed as a global package; brain clones are content-only and inherit skills, prompts, themes, tools, and the extension from the install.
author: Muhamed Isabegovic

scripts.test: tsx tests/load.test.ts && tsx tests/integration.test.ts && tsx tests/commands.test.ts && tsx tests/refinement.test.ts && tsx tests/autonomy.test.ts && tsx tests/brain-home.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && node tools/brain-sync.mjs && node tools/brain-links.mjs
